counting_semantics: Sum of atomic release-blocker rows and infrastructure limitation records. ledger-atomic-assurance-incomplete is retained as a separately owned summary limitation, so this is a blocking-record count, not a claim of statistically independent risks.

limitations.reason: Workflow action commits are pinned but their source archives and transitive action content are not frozen.
No independently schema-validated production or isolated-workspace SBOM is frozen.
tools/bench-processor is a tracked Cargo workspace with an ignored lockfile and non-exact dependency requirements.
BLS expected hashes exist in source, but fresh complete emissions are not retained or independently replayed.
The twelve post-v3 candidate .crate archives have not been rebuilt from the freeze subject.
No target-qualified compiled-artifact byte manifest exists for the freeze subject.
No immutable OCI build environment is declared or available.
Locked dependency archive bytes and a cold-cache offline provisioning bundle are not frozen.
GHASH has structural assembly checks but no exact compiler allowlist and complete-emission hash binding.
Historical advisory sources are inventoried, but the exact freeze has not replayed every regression.
All candidate evidence remains first-party generated until a separate reviewer reproduces it.
All 9,298 atomic assurance rows remain release-blocked; a freeze does not promote them.
Cross-compilation is not native AArch64, macOS, or Windows runtime evidence.
The twelve published v3 registry archives have not been acquired into an offline evidence bundle.
ubuntu-24.04 is a mutable hosted-runner label without an image manifest digest.
RustSec checks do not bind the advisory database commit/archive or installed tool bytes.

The locally observed bubblewrap binary can remove the network namespace for structural replay, but its distribution, kernel, namespace policy, and host isolation assumptions are not provisioned or independently bound.
No canonical source archive has been generated and independently replayed.
Several CI jobs request mutable stable rather than an exact Rust release and component digest.
Compiler metadata is pinned, but distribution, target-component, sysroot, and executable bytes are not bundled.
The exact verification lock graph is reconciled, but independent-oracle lineage, acquisition provenance, and common-mode dependency review are incomplete.
